hooks.command: $d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $d.tool_input.file_path; if ($f) { $leaf = Split-Path $f -Leaf; $verb = if ($d.tool_name -eq 'Write') { 'add' } else { 'update' }; git -C 'D:\IT\PROJECT\VIBE-CODE\emr-system' add $f 2>&1 | Out-Null; $st = git -C 'D:\IT\PROJECT\VIBE-CODE\emr-system' status --porcelain 2>&1; if ($st) { git -C 'D:\IT\PROJECT\VIBE-CODE\emr-system' commit -m "chore: $verb $leaf" 2>&1 | Out-Null; git -C 'D:\IT\PROJECT\VIBE-CODE\emr-system' push origin main 2>&1 | Out-Null } }
